Docs / Guides / Webhooks

Webhooks

Webhooks let your application hear about events in your account as they happen, instead of polling the API. When an event occurs, we send an HTTP POST request with a JSON body to every endpoint you registered for that event type. See the event reference for every type, or read about retries.

Registering an endpoint

  1. Open Settings → Webhooks.
  2. Click Add endpoint and enter an HTTPS URL.
  3. Pick the events to send, then save. The secret is shown once.

Verifying signatures

Each delivery is signed with your endpoint's secret. Verify the signature before you trust the body: compute an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body with the secret and compare it, in constant time, with the value of the Example-Signature header.

import crypto from "node:crypto";

export function verify(body, header, secret) {
  const mac = crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(body).digest("hex");
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(mac), Buffer.from(header));
}

Retries

If your endpoint does not answer with a 2xx status within 10 seconds, the delivery counts as failed and is retried with exponential backoff: after 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes, 2 hours, then every 6 hours for up to 3 days.

AttemptDelayTotal elapsed
11 min1 min
25 min6 min
330 min36 min
42 h2 h 36 min
56 h8 h 36 min

Ordering and duplicates

Deliveries can arrive out of order and, rarely, more than once. Make your handler idempotent by recording the event id and skipping ids you have already processed.
